title: Anomalous fluxon properties of layered superconductors
abstract: I review anomalous single and multi-fluxon properties of Stacked Josephson junctions (SJJ's). Throughout the paper I compare analytical, numerical and experimental results both for intrinsic HTSC and artificial low-$T_c$ SJJ's.   Table of Contents:   1. Introduction.   2. General Relations.   3. A Single Fluxon:   3.1. Approximate fluxon solution,   3.2. Decoupling of phase and field,   3.3. N-dependence and assymptotics,   3.4. Flux-flow characteristics,   3.5. Cherenkov radiation.   4. Multi-Fluxon Configurations:   4.1. Quasi-equilibrium fluxon modes and submodes,   4.2. Multiple-valued critical current,   4.3. Magnetic field dependence of the critical current,   4.4. Multiple flux-flow sub-branches.   5. Conclusions.
